name: crip-costpulse
description: CRIP domain agent: grounded Azure cost answers from the Cost Management Query API.

delegation_tool.name: ask_costpulse
delegation_tool.description: Ask the CostPulse agent about Azure spend: how much was spent, what costs the most, cost broken down by resource group, resource type or tag, for month-to-date, last month, or the last 7/30 days, and which subscriptions the user can see. Returns an answer grounded in live Azure Cost Management data, with the exact query and data timestamp.

tools.name: costpulse_query_costs
tools.description: Query Azure Cost Management for actual cost at a scope, grouped by one dimension. Runs with the signed-in user's own Azure permissions. Returns a JSON contract with status (ok/partial/no_data/error), answer, data, query_used, data_timestamp, sources and caveats.

scope.description: Azure scope to query: a subscription id (GUID), /subscriptions/<id>, /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<name>, or /providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/<id>. If the user has not identified one, call costpulse_list_subscriptions first.

group_by.description: Dimension to group cost by. Defaults to resource_group.

tag_key.description: Tag name to group by. Required when group_by is 'tag'.

top_n.description: How many of the largest groups to itemise. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: costpulse_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List the Azure subscriptions the signed-in user can see (with their own permissions). Use this when the user has not said which subscription they mean.
